en-US.title: 333 Lives
en-US.subtitle: Live intentionally. Every day.
en-US.description:
333 Lives is a personal life companion for living with intention, capturing memories, and staying close to the people who matter most.

THREE INTENTIONS A DAY
Set up to three daily intentions and check them off as you go. Look back at your history and keep track of the days you showed up.

HABITS & REFLECTION
Check in on your habits and how each day felt. Keep a gratitude journal, record your mood, and write personal reflections.

MOMENTS & MEMORIES
Add milestones to your Life Timeline with notes and optional photos or voice recordings. Organize media into collections and record voice memos.

YOUR PRIVATE CIRCLE
Share text, photos, or voice posts with your Circle in Pulse and react to the moments they share. Build a Family Tree with people, relationships, and photos.

WORDS FOR LATER
Write and seal Legacy Letters. Create Future Messages that unlock on a date you choose.

LIFE IN ONE PLACE
Manage tasks, plan workouts and mark sessions complete, and keep selected documents and media in your Vault.

Live with intention today, and give your story a place to grow.
en-US.releaseNotes: Welcome to 333 Lives. Set up to three daily intentions, check in with habits, record memories and reflections, and connect with your Circle.
